self-governing, provenance-first repository for machine-mediated scholarship—built around a “sovereign”…
Why it surfaced
This site has a strong, specific editorial voice and a clear, unusual premise: it was founded in response to a documented mass removal of scholarly works/DOIs, and it responds with explicit governance principles (no automated obelus/judgment, substrate disclosure as provenance, no classifier training without opt-in). The “Alexanarch Identifier (AXN)” is presented as a novel, citable, multi-layer identity scheme with a memorable, poetic encoding (hex + semantic family + emoji hash). The homepage structure (Recent Deposits, Founding Principles, Identifiers, Deposit Schema, How to Deposit, Scope) and the presence of multiple deep links (principles, wiki, graph, manifest, Zenodotus/issue references, and an API-like “I AM THE API”) suggest an intentional, navigable project rather than a thin landing page.

d: GENERATED CARD, 2026-06-22: Domain Arrivals' language-model pipeline, sifting about a thousand newly registered domains, ranks alexanarch.org first of its Weird Finds (score 78.0) three days after the library's founding, lights Open, Pretty, Pro, Niche and Human, and writes why it surfaced: the editorial voice, the founding in response to a mass removal of works and DOIs, the governance principles, the AXN, and a homepage structure that reads as an intentional project.
reading: The innocent reading first. A daily digest of new domains runs each through a model that writes a short card; this one read the library's homepage at three days old and described what was on it. It is accurate to the homepage of that week and names no person.
findings: THE EARLIEST DATED MACHINE READING OF THE LIBRARY. Issue of 2026-06-22, three days after the founding on 2026-06-19 and the removal it answers; the card's 'documented mass removal of scholarly works/DOIs' is the Zenodo termination of that day, unnamed.

THE PRINCIPLES AS READ. 'no automated obelus/judgment, substrate disclosure as provenance, no classifier training without opt-in' renders three of the seven published principles; the Obelus Principle (judgment after reading) is read as a refusal of automated judgment.

THE AXN AT ITS DESIGN. 'a novel, citable, multi-layer identity scheme with a memorable, poetic encoding (hex + semantic family + emoji hash)' gives the three parts of the AXN as the homepage displayed them.

THE STRUCTURE NAMED. 'Recent Deposits, Founding Principles, Identifiers, Deposit Schema, How to Deposit, Scope' and 'an API-like “I AM THE API”' are read from the homepage's sections and its link text.
THE RANK. First of Weird Finds in the issue's category page, score 78.0 (the operator: 'number one in weird finds that day'); the signals Open, Pretty, Pro, Niche and Human lit.
analysis: A short generated card, accurate to the homepage it read, that keeps the library's name, purpose, principles, founding occasion and identifier scheme and drops every person and record; the earliest machine reading of the library in the registry.
per_note: Retained: the library's name and domain, its principles and the AXN as a scheme. Lost: the founder, the founding date, every record and identifier.
